***

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(cowplot)

egenes_per_celltype_file <- params$egenes_per_celltype
overlap_file             <- params$overlap
isoform_summary_file     <- params$isoform_summary

# Benchmark files of the current rules, passed by the rule as rule=path pairs
benchmark_pairs <- strsplit(params$benchmarks, ",")[[1]]
benchmark_files <- tibble(rule = sub("=.*", "", benchmark_pairs),
                          file = sub("^[^=]*=", "", benchmark_pairs))
```

## Replication (bulk) pipeline steps {.tabset}

***

We compared our snRNA-seq eGenes with bulk RNA-seq eQTL from 120 second-trimester
human fetal brains, mapped at the gene and transcript level. The citation for the
bulk eQTL is [O'Brien et al. (2018), DOI: 10.1186/s13059-018-1567-1](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-018-1567-1).

***

1. `extract_unique_egenes`: Extract unique FDR-sig eGenes across all L1+L2+pseudotime cell types
2. `overlap_obrien`: Overlap unique fetal eGenes against O'Brien 2018 bulk gene- and transcript-level significant eQTL
3. `isoform_eqtl_comparison`: Compare fetal eGenes against bulk transcript-level eQTL for evidence of isoform-specific regulation
4. `repl_bulk_report`: Summarise replication (bulk) results

***

### Bulk overlap {.tabset}

***

```{r load-and-join, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# egenes_per_celltype: one row per (cell_type, eGene) -- which cell type(s)
# each eGene was significant in.
# overlap: one row per unique eGene ACROSS all cell types -- whether it's
# gene-/transcript-bulk significant, no cell_type column at all.
# Joined here (not a separate pipeline rule -- both inputs are already
# tracked outputs, and this is a plain join + group_by/summarise, the same
# complexity as the summary tables below).
egenes_per_celltype <- read_tsv(egenes_per_celltype_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
overlap             <- read_tsv(overlap_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

joined <- egenes_per_celltype |>
  left_join(overlap, by = "phenotype_id")

n_unmatched <- sum(is.na(joined$in_gene_bulk))
if (n_unmatched > 0) {
  warning(n_unmatched, " (cell_type, phenotype_id) rows had no matching overlap record -- ",
          "check egenes_per_celltype and overlap came from the same extract_unique_egenes run.")
}

celltype_overlap <- joined |>
  group_by(cell_type, level) |>
  summarise(
    n_egenes                  = n_distinct(phenotype_id),
    n_gene_bulk_overlap       = sum(in_gene_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_transcript_bulk_overlap = sum(in_transcript_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Custom colour palette -- identical to the LDSR report's, so cell types
# read the same colour across every report in this project.
custom_palette <- c(
  'Glu-UL' = '#4363d8',
  'Glu-DL' = '#00B6EB',
  'NPC' = '#FF5959',
  'GABA' = '#3CBB75FF',
  'Endo-Peri' = '#B200ED',
  'MG' = '#F58231',
  'OPC' = '#FDE725FF',
  'Trajectory-to-Glu-UL' = '#E91E8C',
  'Trajectory-to-Glu-DL' = '#2F4F4F'
)

# Dependency-free lighten (base R col2rgb/rgb) -- avoids requiring the
# colorspace package just for this one report.
lighten_colour <- function(hex, amount = 0.55) {
  rgb_mat <- col2rgb(hex)
  rgb_light <- rgb_mat + (255 - rgb_mat) * amount
  rgb(rgb_light[1, ], rgb_light[2, ], rgb_light[3, ], maxColorValue = 255)
}

# --- Family / trajectory detection, matching the LDSR report's logic exactly
# (trajectory check BEFORE the family cascade, since "NPC-to-Glu-UL-Q4-Bin1"
# contains "Glu-UL" as a substring and would otherwise be mis-classified).
celltype_overlap <- celltype_overlap |>
  mutate(
    is_trajectory = str_detect(cell_type, "-to-"),
    main_type = case_when(
      is_trajectory & str_detect(cell_type, "to-Glu-UL") ~ "Trajectory-to-Glu-UL",
      is_trajectory & str_detect(cell_type, "to-Glu-DL") ~ "Trajectory-to-Glu-DL",
      str_detect(cell_type, "Glu-UL") ~ "Glu-UL",
      str_detect(cell_type, "Glu-DL") ~ "Glu-DL",
      str_detect(cell_type, "GABA") ~ "GABA",
      str_detect(cell_type, "NPC") ~ "NPC",
      str_detect(cell_type, "OPC") ~ "OPC",
      str_detect(cell_type, "MG") ~ "MG",
      str_detect(cell_type, "Endo-Peri") ~ "Endo-Peri",
      TRUE ~ cell_type
    )
  )

# --- x-axis order: 3 LEVEL blocks (L1, L2, pseudotime), family order within
# each block (not family-interleaved across the whole axis).
l1_order <- c("Glu-UL", "Glu-DL", "GABA", "NPC", "Endo-Peri", "MG", "OPC")
l2_order <- c("Glu-UL-0", "Glu-UL-1", "Glu-UL-2",
              "Glu-DL-0", "Glu-DL-1", "Glu-DL-2",
              "GABA-0", "GABA-1", "GABA-2",
              "NPC-0", "NPC-1", "NPC-2")
pt_order <- c(sort(grep("^NPC-to-Glu-UL", celltype_overlap$cell_type, value = TRUE)),
              sort(grep("^NPC-to-Glu-DL", celltype_overlap$cell_type, value = TRUE)))

cell_order <- c(l1_order, l2_order, pt_order)
cell_order <- cell_order[cell_order %in% celltype_overlap$cell_type]

celltype_overlap <- celltype_overlap |>
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_order))

# x position: sequential within a block, with a gap ONLY at the 2 block
# boundaries (L1->L2, L2->pseudotime) -- not at every family transition.
block_order <- celltype_overlap |>
  arrange(cell_type) |>
  distinct(cell_type, level) |>
  mutate(level = factor(level, levels = c("L1", "L2", "pseudotime"))) |>
  arrange(level, cell_type) |>
  mutate(
    block_change = level != lag(level, default = first(level)),
    x_pos = row_number() + cumsum(block_change) * 2
  )

celltype_overlap <- celltype_overlap |>
  left_join(block_order |> select(cell_type, x_pos), by = "cell_type")

# Two SOLID bar layers, dark drawn first, light drawn second on top (light
# bar is shorter, so it renders as the bottom portion of the same bar) --
# both with black outlines. Theme styling lifted from the LDSR report's plot.
bar_width <- 0.8

plot_overlap_bar <- function(dat, overlap_col, title) {
  dat <- dat |> rename(overlap_n = all_of(overlap_col))
  light_fill <- lighten_colour(custom_palette[as.character(dat$main_type)], amount = 0.55)

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = x_pos)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = n_egenes, fill = main_type), width = bar_width, colour = "black") +
    geom_col(aes(y = overlap_n), fill = light_fill, width = bar_width, colour = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(y = n_egenes, label = n_egenes), vjust = -0.6, size = 3) +
    geom_text(aes(y = overlap_n, label = overlap_n), vjust = -0.6, size = 2.8, colour = "grey20") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = block_order$x_pos, labels = block_order$cell_type) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette, name = "Cell Type") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "eGenes", title = title)
}
```

***

#### Gene-level overlap

Dark bar: total unique eGenes per cell type. Light overlay: of those, how
many also significant in O'Brien et al. 2018's gene-level bulk analysis
(TblS2).

```{r gene-bulk-plot, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
plot_overlap_bar(celltype_overlap, "n_gene_bulk_overlap",
                  "Fetal eGenes overlapping O'Brien gene-level bulk eQTL")
```

***

#### Transcript-level overlap

Dark bar: total unique eGenes per cell type. Light overlay: of those, how
many also significant (gene-deduplicated) in O'Brien et al. 2018's
transcript-level bulk analysis (TblS3).

```{r transcript-bulk-plot, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
plot_overlap_bar(celltype_overlap, "n_transcript_bulk_overlap",
                  "Fetal eGenes overlapping O'Brien transcript-level bulk eQTL")
```

***

#### Summary table

```{r overlap-summary-table, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
tibble(
  Metric = c("Total unique fetal eGenes", "Overlapping O'Brien gene-level bulk (TblS2)",
             "Overlapping O'Brien transcript-level bulk (TblS3)", "Overlapping both"),
  N = c(nrow(overlap),
        sum(overlap$in_gene_bulk),
        sum(overlap$in_transcript_bulk),
        sum(overlap$in_gene_bulk & overlap$in_transcript_bulk))
) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "O'Brien 2018 bulk overlap summary")
```

### Isoform comparison {.tabset}

***

#### Summary table

```{r isoform-summary-table, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
isoform_summary <- read_tsv(isoform_summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

isoform_summary |>
  count(pattern, name = "N") |>
  mutate(Proportion = round(N / sum(N), 3)) |>
  arrange(desc(N)) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Isoform pattern classification",
             subtitle = "Fetal eGene x eSNP pairs vs O'Brien transcript-level bulk eQTL")
```

***

### Benchmarking {.tabset}

***

#### Table

***

```{r benchmarking, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Files not yet written (rules not run) are skipped
benchmarks <- benchmark_files |>
  filter(file.exists(file)) |>
  pmap_dfr(function(rule, file) {
    df <- read.table(file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
    tibble(
      file = file,
      rule = rule,
      runtime_sec = df$s,
      runtime_hms = df$h.m.s.,
      max_rss = df$max_rss
    )
  })

summary <- benchmarks %>%
  group_by(rule) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_runtime_min = mean(runtime_sec) / 60,
    sd_runtime_min = sd(runtime_sec) / 60,
    mean_ram_gb = mean(max_rss) / 1024,
    sd_ram_gb = sd(max_rss) / 1024,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_runtime_min = if_else(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min),
    sd_ram_gb = if_else(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  arrange(rule)

summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Benchmarking",
    subtitle = "Means and SD across replicates"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    rule = "Rule",
    n = "N",
    mean_runtime_min = "Mean Runtime (min)",
    sd_runtime_min = "SD Runtime (min)",
    mean_ram_gb = "Mean RAM (GB)",
    sd_ram_gb = "SD RAM (GB)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_runtime_min, sd_runtime_min, mean_ram_gb, sd_ram_gb),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    heading.align = "center"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )
```

***

#### Plot

***

```{r runtime_plt, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(10, 5)}
runtime_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_runtime_min),
                                 y = mean_runtime_min)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_runtime_min - ifelse(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min), 0),
                    ymax = mean_runtime_min + ifelse(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min)),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "Runtime (minutes)",
       title = "Mean runtime per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

mem_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_ram_gb),
                                y = mean_ram_gb)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_ram_gb - ifelse(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb), 0),
                    ymax = mean_ram_gb + ifelse(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "RAM (GB)",
       title = "Mean RAM usage per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

plot_grid(runtime_plt, mem_plt)
```
